Anna (docs): Heads-up — I'm prepping a model card update to add a telemetry section (latency histograms, p50/p95/p99, cold-starts). Need a small SDK snippet + a curl example for customers to opt into telemetry. Posting plan and asking for owners.

Sam (eng-ml): SGTM. We should call out what telemetry fields we send and the sampling opt-in. For model cards, include an example histogram and a sentence about p99 tail behavior under batching.

Jordan (product): Also add a short note about privacy/PII — telemetry is aggregate only. We'll need the standard blurb used in other cards. @Anna can copy from the observability guideline.

Max (sdk): I can draft an SDK snippet. Prefer JS + python quick examples. Do we want to show the low-level event, or a helper call like `client.telemetry.trackInference`?

Anna (docs): Helper call is better — keeps examples simple. Example section should show: 1) enable telemetry flag, 2) send a sample inference telemetry event, 3) what to expect in the dashboard.

Sam (eng-ml): Telemetry fields: model_name, variant, seq_len, tokens_generated, latency_ms, batch_size, cold_start(bool), experiment_tag. We also export quantized_flag for low-precision runs. Please list those as a table in the card.

Max (sdk): Draft snippet (JS):
```js
// enable telemetry in client config
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, telemetry: { enabled: true, sampling_rate: 0.01 } });
client.telemetry.trackInference({ model: 'polaris-13b', variant: 'q4_0', seq_len: 512, tokens: 120, latency_ms: 123, batch_size: 4, cold_start: false });
```

Max (sdk): And quick curl example for customers who can't use SDKs: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/telemetry \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"polaris-13b","variant":"q4_0","seq_len":512,"latency_ms":123,"tokens":120,"batch_size":4,"cold_start":false}'
```

Anna (docs): Perfect, Max. Can you add a comment about the sampling_rate default and how to change it? Also we need one line about GDPR-safe defaults (no raw prompts).

Max (sdk): Added note in snippet comment: default sampling_rate=0.001 in hosted, change via client config or Console. Will avoid sending prompt text by default.

Sam (eng-ml): For the model card phrasing, add a brief benchmark note: "Under steady-state batching (batch size 4) median latency ~110ms, p95 ~250ms for polaris-13b q4_0 in hosted eu-west." That helps set expectations.

Jordan (product): Nice — also add a link to the console telemetry docs and the bench CSV. I'll paste links in the PR.

Anna (docs): I'll open the docs PR now — will include: telemetry section, fields table, JS + curl snippets, privacy note, benchmark blurb, and a 'how to opt out' line. Assigning reviewers: @Max and @Sam. ETA for draft: EOD today.

```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_API_KEY'), telemetry={'enabled': True})
client.telemetry.track_inference(model='polaris-13b', variant='q4_0', seq_len=512, tokens=120, latency_ms=123)
```
